use.t: 把功能分支 Push 到远程后，在 GitHub 创建 Pull Request
写清目的、主要改动、验证步骤和已知问题
逐页查看改动清单，并等待必要的自动检查通过
确认反馈已经处理后，再按项目约定合入主版本

dont.t: 把 Pull Request 当成可以在终端直接运行的 Git 命令
只写“改好了”，没有说明目的和验证方式
没有查看改动内容，只因为自动检查通过就直接合入
收到反馈后继续修改，却没有重新检查最新变化

lessonPractice.title: 功能分支已提交 PR，自动检查通过，但评审指出手机端按钮被裁掉。下一步怎样处理？

options.label: 自动检查已经通过，先合并再到 main 修手机问题
options.feedback: 自动检查没有覆盖这项手机布局问题；已知缺陷不应因为状态为绿色就进入主版本。

options.label: 在原分支修复并重新验证，再查看 PR 的最新改动
options.feedback: PR 应汇集最新代码、讨论和验证结果；处理反馈后重新检查，才能决定是否合并。

options.label: 关闭原 PR，把相同代码复制到 main 后再修手机问题
options.feedback: 直接复制会绕过原有讨论和改动记录；修复应留在功能分支，让 PR 展示最终差异。

en.title: A feature branch has a pull request with passing checks, but review finds that a button is clipped on mobile. What should happen next?

options.label: Merge because checks passed and fix mobile later on main
options.feedback: The checks did not cover this mobile defect. A known issue should not enter the main line because the status is green.

options.label: Fix it on the same branch, verify again, and review the pull request's latest changes
options.feedback: The pull request should collect the current code, discussion, and verification before the merge decision.

options.label: Close the pull request, copy the same code to main, and fix mobile there
options.feedback: Copying directly bypasses the discussion and change history. The feature branch should contain the reviewed final fix.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: PR 的自动检查通过，但手机端按钮被裁掉。请在原分支修复，重新检查手机和桌面，并更新 PR 的改动说明与验证结果。确认最新 diff 只包含本功能后再请求评审，不要绕过 PR 直接改 main。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Checks pass, but a mobile button is clipped. Fix it on the same branch, recheck mobile and desktop, and update the pull request summary and verification. Confirm the latest diff contains only this feature before requesting review, and do not bypass the PR by editing main.

在 GitHub 上创建 Pull Request

Pull Request 是一个检查页面，不是终端命令。它把“为什么改、改了什么、怎样验证”集中给团队确认，确认后才合入主版本。

Create a Pull Request on GitHub

Pull Request is a check page, not a terminal command. It centralizes "why it was changed, what was changed, and how to verify it" to the team for confirmation, and then merges it into the main version after confirmation.

use.t: Keep a record of why a branch entered main

dont.t: Open one request for several unrelated features
Use only the title and provide no context
Merge while required checks or questions remain unresolved
Treat review as permission to skip your own testing

comparison.title: Pull request vs merge request: is there a difference?
comparison.decision: They name the same general review-before-merge workflow. GitHub, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps use Pull Request (PR); GitLab uses Merge Request (MR). Product features still differ.

dimensions.label: Core concept
dimensions.current: A proposal to review branch changes and discuss code diffs before merging into a target branch.
dimensions.other: GitLab's term for proposing, reviewing, and merging changes into a target branch.

dimensions.label: Primary platform
dimensions.current: Standard terminology on GitHub, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps.
dimensions.other: Standard terminology on GitLab and GitLab CE/EE.

dimensions.label: Product details
dimensions.current: Review rules, checks, and merge options depend on the hosting product and repository settings.
dimensions.other: Review rules, pipelines, and merge options depend on GitLab's edition and project settings.

scenario.title: Switching between GitHub and GitLab
scenario.text: On GitHub, a team opens a Pull Request; on GitLab, it opens a Merge Request. Both usually involve reviewing diffs, discussing changes, running checks, and approving a merge, but the available controls and rules depend on the platform and repository settings.
